no_subs.description: Do not subscribe to zephyr messages on startup

tty.description: TTY name to use for the zephyr location

debug_file.description: Debug output file path (only used if debug enabled)

startup_commands.description: List of BarnOwl command-line commands to execute at startup (after config file is loaded). Each item should be a valid BarnOwl command string (e.g., 'set zephyr_autosubscribe 1')
